originalPassage: The fast pace of today's lifestyle has us piling one thing on top of another. But you should know that multitasking doesn't save any time. Very often, multitasking only slows you down, contrary to popular belief. Give your whole focus to what you're doing at the moment no matter what it is. While doing the laundry, just do the laundry: Listen to the sound of the water as it fills the washing machine and feel the clothes in your hand. It doesn't take up any more time than it would when done with your phone pressed to your ear. The same applies to your work. Focus on one task at a time, and you'll accomplish each task better, and probably faster.

question.explanation: that절 내부의 주어는 동명사구인 'multitasking'입니다. 동명사 주어는 단수 취급하므로 동사 또한 단수형태가 되어야 합니다. 따라서 복수형 조동사 don't는 이 자리에 올 수 없으며 단수형인 'doesn't'로 고쳐야 합니다. 동명사 주어 뒤에 긴 수식어가 없더라도 문장 전체의 구조적 일관성을 확인해야 하는 기초적인 수일치 문제입니다.
keyPoints: (A) 주어-동사 수일치 — 동명사 주어는 단수 취급하므로 doesn't를 요구함
(B) 관계사 what vs 명사절 that — 타동사 doing의 목적어가 비어 있으므로 선행사를 포함한 what이 적절함
(D) 분사구문 능수동 — 목적어 your phone과 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 pressed를 씀
question.passageWithMarkers: The fast pace of today's lifestyle has us piling one thing on top of another. But you should know that multitasking __(A) don't__ save any time. Very often, multitasking only slows you down, contrary to popular belief. Give your whole focus to __(B) what__ you're doing at the moment no matter what it is. __(C) While doing__ the laundry, just do the laundry: Listen to the sound of the water as it fills the washing machine and feel the clothes in your hand. It doesn't take up any more time than it would when done with your phone __(D) pressed__ to your ear. The same applies to your work. Focus on one task at a time, and you'll accomplish each task better, and probably __(E) faster__.
